主要内容: On February 19, 2013, the Board of Directors of Insperity, Inc. approved the adoption of the First Amendment to the Insperity, Inc. 2012 Incentive Plan. The amendment modified the terms of the Plan to no longer automatically accelerate vesting of awards upon a change in control, provided the award agreement terms allow for such modification. The amendment is referenced in Exhibit 10.1 to this Form 8-K. Additionally, the Board approved an amendment to the Directors Compensation Plan to reflect changes to director compensation outlined in Appendix A. The amendment is referenced in Exhibit 10.6. These changes affect the compensation structure and vesting conditions for executives and directors of Insperity, Inc..
